scope: Local macOS arm64 normal canonical server telephone TOML installation, owned startup/drop/shutdown cleanup, public callback movement/cancellation and answered refusal/restart behavior with isolated IPv4 SIP/RTP fixtures.
behavior: CanonicalServerConfig.telephone loads explicit SIP bind/RTP bounds, route credential references and frozen telephone policy from TOML. The normal server installs the adapter on the same Core before HTTP/native intake; no test host hook installs the configured cases. Endpoint destinations remain independently provisioned and verified Store facts.

One configured PCMU actual movement and the two existing PCMU/PCMA host moves preserve attributed private 55# readiness, independent established duplex, old source/controller revocation, late cancellation, preparation expiry, replay without redial and own-route loss cleanup.

A configured public ringing cancellation preserves original duplex and releases UDP/TCP listeners. Missing route account refuses before binding and releases installation custody. Later HTTP bind failure cleans an already started SIP listener; dropping a live server also releases its owned SIP sockets.

Configured shutdown during actual ringing sends CANCEL and observes ACK, then releases SIP sockets. A new normal server reuses that listener; public operation.get and matching transition replay retain unknown and emit no further INVITE.

Answered PCMU input without digits models an audio-producing endpoint such as voicemail; it cannot satisfy configured confirmation or move. Incorrect 99# also stays unready and times out. Cancellation during actual private duplex sends BYE. All three retain zero readiness/commit result, one call across replay, original native duplex and released configured listeners.

Five installed CLI initialization/serving tests still pass with telephone omitted, including signed client enrollment, receipt restart/replay and configuration/key/file refusal. Twenty-two current Service tests pass; its sources are unchanged by the server composition work.
preliminary_observations: The new nested test module initially used the default module path despite its parent explicit path attribute; formatting refused that path. An explicit telephone/configured.rs path corrected it before compilation. This was not a passing check.

Early two-case configured movement/cancel and six-case configured cleanup runs passed. The final unchanged-source all-fifteen telephone run includes their required behavior and the three additional answered refusal cases; earlier overlapping totals are not added.
Obsolete generated SIP libraries/incremental caches were removed with local manifests to keep compiler space available. Sources, patches and historical standalone test executables were retained.
not_qualified: Current telephone lifetime/claim recovery after a known completed movement across server restart; full late old-leg/unknown physical submission and private-phase restart fault matrix.
Telephone-to-other-device movement and mixed selector/role/private-context churn; established refresh INVITE wire qualification.

Optional trunk/registration fields reuse the existing server SIP composition, but canonical carrier registration/failure profiles are not exercised by these tests. No provider/PSTN/Linux/browser/remote/performance/independent acceptance or publication claim.
